== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Nine]] is a sun-tanned, weathered man with dark hair in tiny braids and a leather eyepatch over his right eye.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Nine]] and [[Eight]] do not use their real names on this trip.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Nine]] and [[Eight]] wear a gold crest on their shirts.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Nine]] is a one-eyed man with a scarred back.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
